_doc: JLCPCB standard PCB capabilities mapped to KiCad Board Setup rules, keyed by layer count and outer copper weight. economical_via_drill_mm (board review rev. 0.2, issue 11, 2026-10-20): the smallest via drill at the standard price - on 4/6 layers 0.15 mm is manufacturable but charged extra, so apply_settings.js makes 0.45 / 0.2 (economical_via_diameter_mm / economical_via_drill_mm) the small predefined via unless --fine-vias (netclass drills below it are reported); 2-layer omits the key because its minimum drill (0.3) is already above it. Values captured from jlcpcb.com/capabilities (standard FR-4 service) on 2026-09-17. They are limits, not targets: the standard's own values apply whenever they are stricter. Before every fabrication order re-check the live page and update 'captured' and any changed value. All lengths in mm.

1oz._doc: Standard: 1 oz outer, 0.5 oz inner on multilayer

2oz._doc: Heavy copper outer; inner 1 oz on multilayer. Larger min track/clearance.

notes: Edge clearance 0.3 mm routed, 0.4 mm for V-cut panels.
2 oz outer copper: 0.2 mm track and clearance minimum.

absolute_min._doc: Hard floors an approved project deviation may go down to (kicad_golden.project.json approved_rule_deviations). min_hole_clearance 0.2 = JLCPCB via hole to track (ServiceOne D110, 2026-10-20); the profile keeps 0.254 as the default rule.

stackup._doc: JLC standard 4-layer (JLC04161H-7628 class): 1 oz outer, 0.5 oz inner. The golden file declares 35 µm on all four layers — correct the inner copper in the stackup editor to 0.0175 mm when using this profile.

notes: Via hole 0.15 mm / diameter 0.25 mm minimum on 4-6 layer.

This is the profile the golden standard was built for. The reviewer's netclass via drill of 0.15 mm is within this limit; the golden rule min_through_hole_diameter 0.20 is stricter and may be relaxed to 0.15 under this profile.

notes: 2 oz outer copper: 0.2 mm track and clearance minimum on outer layers.
